# Places

<!-- Generated from in-app Help; do not edit by hand. -->

Every ward, ED and community team in the network. The band names the wards whose bed count needs a check.

## What is on the screen

1. What needs a check. The band names the wards whose bed count is old, with the ward to ask first.
2. Ask the ward. Sends that ward a request to confirm its beds.
3. At a glance. Opens wards that need a bed check, wards by service, and the places you pinned or opened lately.
4. Places and Catchments. Places lists the network. Catchments finds which community team covers a suburb.
5. Search places. Type a ward, hospital, ED, team or service.
6. Sort. Sets how the places are listed: by service or A to Z.
7. Show. All, Wards, EDs or Teams, with how many of each.
8. The network. Every place, grouped by service. Choose one to see who is heading or waiting there, then refer or open it.
9. Community teams. Teams are folded to keep the list short. Open the fold to list them.

In BedChart, open Help and choose Show me around this screen to see each part lit in turn.

_Prototype on synthetic data. Not for real patients._
